title: Mild
description: This is a mod that aims to implement a 'truly' peaceful mode
body:
# Mild

A Minecraft Fabric mod that allows you to enjoy a complete monster ecosystem in Peaceful difficulty.

## Features

All features only take effect in **Peaceful** difficulty:

### 🐾 Monster Ecosystem
- **Monsters spawn naturally**: All monsters (zombies, skeletons, creepers, slimes, etc.) spawn naturally
- **Hostility between mobs preserved**: Monsters still attack each other (e.g., zombies attack villagers, skeletons shoot creepers)
- **Bosses can spawn**: Wither and Ender Dragon can spawn and exist normally

### 🛡️ Player Protection
- **Monsters don't attack players**: All monsters (including bosses) will not target players
- **Global damage immunity**: Players take no damage from any source (falling, suffocation, lava, etc.)
- **Negative effect protection**: Negative effects (poison, wither, hunger, slowness, mining fatigue, etc.) are blocked
- **Void protection**: Players falling into the void are teleported to a safe location and fully healed

### 🍎 Food System
- **Food is always edible**: Food can be consumed even when hunger is full
- **Random buff effects**: Eating food grants 1-3 random beneficial effects (strength, speed, resistance, regeneration, etc.)

### ☀️ Undead Protection
- **Undead mobs don't burn in sunlight**: Zombies, skeletons, and other undead don't burn in sunlight

## Version Support

| Version | Status |
|---------|--------|
| Minecraft 1.20.1 | ✅ Complete |
| Minecraft 26.2 | ✅ Complete |

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Place the Mild mod in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
4. Launch the game and set difficulty to **Peaceful**

## Technical Details

This mod uses Mixin technology to intercept the following Minecraft behaviors:

| Feature | Method Intercepted |
|---------|-------------------|
| Monster Spawning | `EntityType.canSpawn()`, `SpawnPlacements.checkSpawnRules()` |
| Monster Targeting | `Mob.setTarget()` |
| Monster Despawning | `Mob.checkDespawn()` |
| Food Edibility | `ItemStack.isEdible()` |
| Food Effects | `ItemStack.finishUsingItem()` |
| Damage Immunity | `Player.hurtServer()` |
| Negative Effects | `LivingEntity.addEffect()` |
| Void Protection | `Entity.checkBelowWorld()` |
| Sunlight Burning | `Mob.isSunBurnTick()` |
